records.body:

Your Wrenfield account is live. A simple way to start: one project, a handful of real tasks, then an invite to a teammate. No need to overthink the setup.

Here if you need anything.

draft.subject: A first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Mateo,

Following up on my note yesterday — no pressure if things are just busy. If it's helpful, projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so one real project is usually the quickest way to see whether it fits how your team works. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you and answer anything that's come up.

Best,
Nadia
